snippet.title: Sit-Back Attack Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092260/SitBack_Attack
Coming November 24th.
Sit-Back Attack is a new twist to the IDLE RPG genre.
Adding immense amount of challenges and character customization, you will be sure to find the build style that fits you!
Do not hesitate to check it out!

It is releasing November 24th for $8.99 in Early Access.
First week launch discount of 10% so get it quick!
